headline: Two perfect starts, and eighteen days until it counts.
dek: Ouachita Baptist and Rogers State swept the opening weekend — 6–0 and 4–1 on aggregate. The table stays empty until September 17, when Southern Nazarene hosts Harding to open conference play.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Five different players have scored for Ouachita Baptist, more than for any other side in the conference.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Wesley Rodriguez has two goals from four shots — a finish every second attempt.

findings.text: Eleven fixtures sit unresolved — six marked final with no score, five past their date with no result at all. The sites' silence, named rather than dropped.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Seven fixtures carry no box-score link on any collected schedule page: the six marked final without a score, plus Newman's 2–1 loss at Rockhurst on August 29.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
